comparison.objective: Divert two reject cartons from a moving conveyor while preserving good cartons.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed lateral pushing of moving boxes without lifting or disturbing neighbors.
comparison.success_condition: Both rejects stationary on the reject table; both good cartons remain upright on their carriers throughout.
comparison.reason: Conveyor interception and non-prehensile sorting do not test coaxial mandrel stabilization, impact-driven notch fracture, or fragment recovery.
